proposed_additions.title: A Voice Against the Stone
proposed_additions.story: Among weathered stone and young pines, a bull elk lifts his head and calls into the mountain air. His antlers catch the light while the forest stands silent around him. For a moment, the whole wild country seems to listen.
proposed_additions.master_status: Web upload only; locate original full-resolution master before offering prints

proposed_additions.title: Gold Along the Waterline
proposed_additions.story: Autumn color spreads across the valley beneath a gathering sky, and a blue mountain lake catches the light between the trees. Beyond the golden slopes, the high peaks rise in cool shadow. The season is turning, but the land is not yet ready to let go of its color.
proposed_additions.master_status: Web upload only; locate original full-resolution master before offering prints

proposed_additions.title: The Meadow Finds Its River
proposed_additions.story: A narrow stream curves through green meadow grass toward the dark forest and a rugged mountain skyline. The valley seems to open slowly, one bend at a time, with the water drawing a quiet path through the open country.
